card.name: Linking words in travel advice
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs such as while, during, if, for, around and visit that follow a travel or tourist statement, just before a place or trip is mentioned again. Seen in sightseeing tips and travel-health advice.

modes.label: Sightseeing tips
modes.description: Words like while, visit and if after a landmark is recommended to visitors.
modes.example: Fifth Avenue between 50th and 51st Streets is directly across from Rockefeller Center makes it one of the iconic New York landmarks to visit<< while>> in Manhattan.

modes.label: Travel health advice
modes.description: Words like during, for and around in advice about staying in or going to a risk area.

card.plain: It fires on little linking words in travel advice, where the text is about to refer to a trip or traveler.
